summary: Mako Mining Corp. filed a Form 6-K containing unaudited interim consolidated financial statements and MD&A for the three months ended March 31, 2026. The filing includes operational results with revenue of $68.6M and net income of $23.1M. A reference to 'Acquisition of Mt. Hamilton LLC' exists in the notes, but no transaction terms or special situation details are provided in the excerpt. The filing is a routine periodic financial report of a foreign private issuer, not a special situation.
